headline.en: Barcelona have seven goals and none conceded before Rayo
headline.es: El Barca lleva siete goles y cero encajados antes del Rayo

summary.en: After Elche and Athletic, Barcelona have scored seven and conceded none. Those matches were not the same. Rayo Vallecano defend in a low block. Monday at 21:30 is the first time this start meets a team set up to sit in.
summary.es: Siete a favor y cero en contra. El Rayo se cierra. El lunes a las 21:30 es otra prueba.

body.en:
Elche were beaten 5-0. Athletic Club were beaten 2-0 and still needed Unai Simon to keep the score down. Combined, Barcelona have scored seven Liga goals and conceded none. Rayo Vallecano will not play like either of those sides. They defend deep and look for space behind the full-backs.

Flick has to decide the left-back, the left winger, and whether anyone starts as a closer reference up front. Two wins do not guarantee a third. Monday at 21:30 is the first low-block night of the season. If Barcelona still create chances, the start is holding. If they spend an hour circulating in front of the penalty area, Athletic was the more generous opponent.

headline.en: Flick has the press from his first season back. October will test it
headline.es: Flick ha recuperado la presion de su primer ano. Octubre lo examina

summary.en: Mundo Deportivo said the first two Liga games look like Flick's first season: a high press and quick attacks. In October Barcelona go to Galatasaray and Paris in consecutive weeks. Raphinha, Pedri and Yamal will need support in those matches.
summary.es: Los dos primeros partidos se parecen a la primera temporada de Flick. En octubre hay Galatasaray y PSG fuera.

body.en:
The first two Liga matches have been vertical and aggressive. Mundo Deportivo compared them with Flick's first season at the club. That press needs bodies. Rodri is still doing gym work after the World Cup. Gavi missed Saturday. Pedri has started. Gordon can run when Raphinha needs to come off.

In October the calendar sends Barcelona to Galatasaray and Paris in consecutive away weeks. If those players are fit, the comparison with year one holds. If they are not, Barcelona will try the same idea with fewer people. The idea is already visible. The question later in the autumn is whether the midfield can play it three times in eight days.

headline.en: Yamal played an hour at Elche and 90 minutes against Athletic
headline.es: Yamal jugo una hora en Elche y 90 minutos ante el Athletic

summary.en: Flick said after Elche that Yamal had three weeks off, trained for a few days, and still played about an hour. Against Athletic he played the full match and hit the post. Luis de la Fuente has talked about calling him back to Spain.
summary.es: Flick dijo que Yamal venia de tres semanas libres y jugo una hora en Elche. Ante el Athletic completo el partido. De la Fuente habla de la seleccion.

body.en:
Yamal's minutes went from about 60 at Elche to 90 against Athletic Club inside four days. He created chances and hit the post. He did not score. Flick had already said the holiday was three weeks and the training time since then was short. Luis de la Fuente has spoken about calling him into the Spain squad.

Barcelona play Rayo on Monday and Feyenoord on 9 September at 18:45. The staff can keep the next step shorter than a full match. They can also play him again and take him into that European week at full load. There is no injury bulletin. The decision this week is the number of minutes. A Liga goal can wait. A second jump from 90 minutes into a midweek, with Spain in the same window, is the part that needs a plan.
